data.name: Thierry
data.gender_notes: Thierry is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Germanic name Theodoric, meaning 'god's power, god's rule'. In ancient Germany, Thierry was a name given to warriors and leaders. The name Thierry carries the meaning “Brave rule, powerful leader” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Thierry usually hope their child will grow to embody brave rule, powerful leader and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Thierry is a name that signifies strength, courage, and leadership. It is a name that is deeply rooted in Christian spirituality and is often given to those who are destined for great things in life.
data.etymology: Thierry belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brave rule, powerful leader.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Thierry total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
